name: onyxias_lair
notes: DRAFT: the dungeongen skeleton (spec tools/dungeongen/plans.json) prepped in task B1 (TortoiseBots-audit RAID-PREP-ony.md) from the world DB (base plus database_updates, the two trees setup_databases.sh applies), the core's onyxias_lair scripts and the server's map 249 navmesh. Not mapped, not live-checked: the GM-invisible mapping walk (B2) and the first live run are still to do; dungeon_run refuses it without allow_draft.

Census: map 249 holds 6 creature spawns and nothing else hostile: Onyxia 10184 (rank 3, boss_onyxia, at 0.70 -211.97 -86.08) and five Onyxian Warders 12129 (rank 1 elites: 49.82 -114.61 -24.31, -52.97 -96.88 -38.64, -131.20 -137.47 -52.52, -166.62 -196.00 -66.26, -199.10 -209.83 -68.91). Four of the five patrol (creature_movement: 80.5, 110.5, 158.9 and 98.3 yd paths); their blocks carry the path and a period estimated at 2.5 yd/s (32, 44, 64, 39 s), which plan-check warns about and the mapping walk measures.

Packs: no two warders stand within 15 yd of one another (the closest pair, the fourth and fifth, are 35.4 yd apart), so the 5 pull groups stay 5: one unit each, radius 1. Nothing is merged, no patrol is merged into a trash pull, and there is no linked group on the map (creature_linking, creature_linking_template and creature_groups have no map 249 row). The five are the lair's only trash.

Boss: Onyxia 10184, the only boss, killed last. boss_onyxia.cpp: she sleeps until a player is within 58 yd (CheckForTargetsInAggroRadius) and then fights where she stands; at 65 % health she takes off (Hover 17131) and at 40 % she lands. The plan has no phase or event step: the phases are health thresholds in the script, and no gossip, object or door starts the fight.

Warders on aggro: Onyxia's Aggro respawns every dead Onyxian Warder within 200 yd (boss_onyxia.cpp Aggro; GetCreatureListWithEntryInGrid measures 2D, GridNotifiers.h AllCreaturesOfEntryInRange IsWithinDist(..., false)). The five warders stand 109.1, 127.0, 151.5, 168.1 and 199.8 yd from her in 2D, so all five come back alive when she is pulled. No step kind can prevent this (BLOCKER for B2: watch what a boss pull after the clear really spawns).

Leash: she enters evade mode as soon as she stands at x < -95 (boss_onyxia.cpp LeashIfOutOfCombatArea), so the fight is fought at the east side of the chamber: her spawn x is 0.70 and the boss stand is -80.0, 15 yd east of the line.

Whelps and eggs: Onyxia summons Onyxian Whelps 11262 in the air phase (afSpawnLocations -30.13 -254.46 -89.44 and -30.82 -177.11 -89.26) and after she lands; the map has 95 Onyxia Egg objects 176511 in the west egg field (about -49 -160, floor z -93) and 52 lava-fissure objects (176513-176515, 176809-176842, 176908-176922) plus the two lava traps 177984/177985. No step kind expresses "stay out of the egg field": the bots' own Onyxia strategy does (onyxia eggs near -> onyxia avoid eggs, onyxia whelps -> onyxia kill whelps, AiPlayerbot.OnyxiaWhelpsAndEggs, on by default).

No door, lever, key or gossip gates the route: map 249's 149 game objects are the eggs, the lava fissures and the two lava traps, all at state 1, and the instance script has no door (instance_onyxia_lair.cpp only summons a whelp from GO_WHELP_SPAWNER 176510, of which the map has none). So the plan has no use_on, wait_object, gossip or hold step.

Whelps come from the boss, not the walls: the instance script's spawner object is absent from the map, and every whelp is SummonCreature in boss_onyxia.cpp (phase 2: 16, then 5-7 every 30 s; phase 3: one every 1-10 s).

Approach points: every pack and the boss get a stand on their own floor with a complete server path from the previous row (15-20 yd from a pack; the boss's is 80.7 yd out, so it breaks the 15-20 yd band and keeps the raid's follow ring out of her wake), so the run leader does not walk toward a pack it cannot see in hops of its own (the draft had 5 such hops of 105-270 yd). plan-check: ok, the run-leader hop notice on the boss stand and the 4 estimated-patrol warnings only (the new wake rule, boss wake_yd 58 + bounding_yd 3.6 + a bot 0.5 + the raid ring 8 + 5 margin = 75.1 yd, passes).

Boss pull: she wakes on the first player within 58 yd (boss_onyxia.cpp CheckForTargetsInAggroRadius), measured in 3D with both bounding radii added, so her real wake is about 62 yd; the raid's formation puts its front bots 5-7 yd ahead of the lead while it walks in. The boss stand is -80.0 -211.4 -83.0: 80.7 yd from her spawn in 3D (0.70 -211.97 -86.08), and the walk in needs 75.1 yd (58 + her bounding 3.6 + a bot 0.5 + the raid ring 8 + 5 margin). The leash line stays 15 yd west of the stand. The fight starts with the raid together at the stand (walk 1 woke her at the path row -50.03, 50.7 yd out, with the raid strung out in the chamber mouth).

Turtle 1.18.1 (guide, not in this data): a new section with the optional Broodcommander Axelus 49018, Cindarion 50143, the Onyxian Hatcher 50144, Inciter 49016 and Flamespawn 49017. Their creature_template rows exist (database_updates 20260510092659) but no map 249 spawn, summon or instance-script hook references any of them in the effective world DB, and the core's boss_onyxia.cpp is the vanilla phase script. No leg is written for them; B2 looks for a passage the DB does not have.

Entrance: areatrigger 2848 needs a raid group, level 50 and the Drakefire Amulet (required_condition 16309) and lands at 30.89 -54.08 -5.03 on map 249 (orientation 4.71239); `.tele onyxia` (game_tele 195, map 249, 29.16 -71.34 -8.18) is the way in without the trigger. The portal on the outer map is at -4768.61 -3752.11 53.43 on map 1.
